facts.text: Psilocybin, psilocin, and baeocystin are the main psychedelic compounds responsible for the psychoactive effects of many species in the genus Psilocybe.
facts.source_quote: Psilocybin, psilocin and baeocystin are the main psychedelic compounds responsible for the psychoactive effects of many species in the genus.

facts.text: As a prodrug, psilocybin is quickly converted by the body to psilocin.
facts.source_quote: As a prodrug, psilocybin is quickly converted by the body to psilocin, which has mind-altering effects similar, in some aspects, to those of LSD, mescaline, and DMT.

relations.text: Among the three main psychedelic compounds named for the genus Psilocybe (psilocybin, psilocin, baeocystin), psilocybin is specifically the one identified as being converted by the body into psilocin.

corpus_defect_notes: The native reference_answer for this case is 'psilocin', but the question asks which of the three named compounds (psilocybin, psilocin, baeocystin) IS CONVERTED TO psilocin by the body.
